title: I Need Thee Every Hour
description: I Need Thee Every Hour in Tonic Solfa, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, all five verses with the refrain, and a piano.
about: Annie Sherwood Hawks, a homemaker in Brooklyn, New York, wrote these words in 1872. Her pastor, Robert Lowry, set them to music and added the refrain; the hymn became widely known through the Moody and Sankey meetings.
underlay: I need Thee ev-’ry hour, Most gra_-cious_ Lord; No ten-der voice like Thine Can peace_ af_-ford. I need Thee, O I need Thee; Ev-’ry hour I need Thee; O bless me now, my Sav-iour, I come_ to Thee!

verses.label: Refrain
lines: I need Thee, O I need Thee;
O bless me now, my Saviour,
